address: Audley Willicombe Park, Willicombe House, Tunbridge Wells, Kent,TN2 3UU
bio: Fairmile Restaurant is based in an impressive Victorian villa, which was originally built in 1872 and owned and named after local property developer William Willicombe. The house was one of the biggest in an area, which was known as “Tunbridge Wells Millionaires row”, and is surrounded by four acres of grounds.  Audley Willicombe Park offers a variety of dining spaces, from the cosy and relaxing Fairmile Restaurant, to the outside terrace, or enjoy the sunshine on the lawn overlooking the fountain.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes freshly made sandwiches, home-made scones, strawberry jam and clotted cream, as well as other delicious sweet treats. The Afternoon Tea can be complimented with a glass of sparkling wine, Champagne, or cocktail.  Afternoon Tea costs 19.95 and is served 12pm - 3:30pm Monday - Saturday.
